scenes: opencode courier: sessions hand work to other sessions, and are woken when they report.
scenes.A join group: The parent starts two children in one join group. One reports at once, and its report is held with the group. The other asks for a permission, so the footer says one is waiting on you. Courier tree opens the panel: Digby the mole, and a row for each child with what it waits on.
scenes.A click opens a child: Click a row, and you are in that child's session, with the panel following you there. This one waits on the permission. Click the other, and there is the report it sent.
scenes.The asks inbox: Back on the parent, the asks inbox lists what the tree waits on you for. Allow it there, the child reports, and both reports reach the parent in one message. The parent then notes a one line lesson on the tree's record.
scenes.A child whose turn fails: A child whose turn fails. OpenCode says the session failed, the parent is told at once, and the panel's row reads failed.
scenes.A child that ends its turn without a rep: A child that ends its turn without a report. The parent is told so, with the child's last reply, and the panel's row says so too.
scenes./courier stop: Courier stop. Pick the session, confirm, and it is stopped, with every session under it.
scenes.A form only you can answer: A form only you can answer. A child's web search shows a form. The footer, the panel row and the asks inbox all point to it, and answering it there lets the child go on, which wakes the parent.
scenes.The memory view: Courier memory lists the project's session trees: how each was split, how its parts went, and the lesson its top session noted. Pin one, and it is listed first and never swept.
scenes.Recall from another tree: A new tree calls courier recall, and gets the pinned record first, lesson and all, before it decides how to split its own work.
